Clicking the teacher's primary "Advance" button during PLAY with an open, uncommitted night for m2l1-full-house shows NO confirmation dialog (trade-deadline and free-agency lessons both warn before an equivalent early-PLAY advance via advanceWarnState; full-house has no such guard wired in main.ts) — a single misclick silently skips all remaining unplayed nights.

A single unwarned teacher misclick on the primary Advance control during PLAY (any open night, not just the last) silently forecloses ALL remaining unplayed nights for the whole class, auto-settling them at the plan price with zero further student agency — combined with the missing confirm() dialog (finding 21b) this is a real one-tap classroom accident with no recovery path other than ending/restoring the session.
